name: Ogata Kokona
source:
The junk shop “Junk Pod” clerk who suddenly started quietly dropping by (?) with the heroines.

A big sister type who's into mechs and a bit of an otaku girl. She's even been made to sell slightly risqué items without knowing their purpose, just because the shop owner recommended them?

She frequently appears for tasks like repairing the academy walls or setting up events, so everyone treats her like a “jack-of-all-trades.”

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/ironmaiden/chara.html]official site[/url]]
